reply.text: I can't see your squad's activity, so I can't tell you where the streaks stand. What I can see is your own record, and that's the one worth measuring against. Let me pull your recent training so we know where you actually are. I pulled your training summary for the last 12 weeks and nothing came back, so there's nothing logged in that window yet. I can't see your squad's streaks, so I can't tell you how far behind you are, and chasing someone else's number isn't much use anyway. What matters is getting your own log moving: pick a session you can finish this week and log it, and we'll build the streak from there. Tell me what days you can realistically train and I'll work out what that looks like with you.
